time_boundary.rule: Do not begin mutations unless conservative remaining duration including verification and safe stop fits; never extend implicitly.

target.digest_rule: Capture immutable application image digest after authorized build; verify app parity and versions before first site mutation. No floating upstream refs.

rules: Explicitly resolve every image/network/volume/project/site name before start; compose -p alone insufficient.
No application source bind; no shared mounts including anonymous logs.
DB and Redis have no host ports.
Fresh local credentials only, outside Git, files 0600 directory 0700.
Deny real SMTP/provider/TS/SdI and runtime external egress; simulated synthetic fixtures only.
Do not execute original hardcoded UAT, m97 or CAP037 provisioners.

protected_resources_rule: All existing containers, images/tags, named and anonymous volumes, networks, services, cron, databases and source checkout unchanged. Inventory IDs/start/restarts/mounts before and after. No global cleanup/prune or Docker settings changes.

preflight_observed.note: Read-only process metadata shows no build/bench/git process, but multiple Codex processes; this alone does not prove exclusive host access. No scripts executed.
compose_notes: 9 services, 4 exclusive named volumes, internal network, no source bind, frontend loopback 8099 only.
No configurator auto-run; bootstrap/migrate/restore remain separate explicitly gated operations.
Validated with nonsecret placeholders only; no credentials created or read.
Generated Compose proposal remains outside repository and is not authorized for execution.

components: Complete native database backup with no include/exclude filtering
Site config and necessary encryption key securely held
Common site settings sanitized manifest and secret-bearing original held privately
Installed apps and versions, source parity, immutable CURRENT image archive
checkpoint.quiescence: Only new lab; stop writes and scheduler/workers coherently; verify no pending jobs before complete checkpoint, otherwise stop and document. Never quiesce existing projects.
checkpoint.storage: Encrypted private archive outside Git and outside Docker pruning domain; custody separate from sanitized report; checksums and verified decrypt integrity.
checkpoint.image_retention: Save complete CURRENT image and required pinned images outside Docker store before upgrade; hash and retain through Owner review. Local tag alone unsafe because scheduled image prune. No cron modification.

execution_sequence: Satisfy every pre-mutation gate; re-read time and remote source; preserve metadata inventory.
Create independent CURRENT site using G2D-proven recipe redirected exclusively to new lab; prepare deterministic synthetic discriminating fixtures.
Quiesce only new lab, capture full checkpoint and normalized pre-upgrade inventories, verify archive integrity and CURRENT image recovery.
Build TARGET from exact product source and official pinned apps without manual patches; record final image digest and inspect dependency/asset/app parity.
Change only new lab application services to TARGET, native migrate with preserved exit code, no --skip-failing, then assets/runtime health.
Compare patch log/schema/permissions and canonical data; run redirected existing 39 suites plus target-specific discriminants.

Execute actual rollback even on TARGET PASS: fresh isolated recovery volumes with exact CURRENT image, native DB/public/private restore and securely held config; no old code against migrated target DB.
Preserve independent restore exit code; compare full pre-checkpoint normalized schema/custom metadata/security/business/file fingerprints before further mutative smoke.
Verify CURRENT functional/security smoke and protected inventories; retain lab/evidence; stop by effective hard deadline.
target_specific_discriminants: ERPNext native/custom permission migration, Payment Terms/Bank Account/Customer/Supplier/Cost Center/Company and role positives/negatives
Six effective before_request guards in original order through real WSGI and 55 HTTP security cases
Cross-center, professional A/B/C, assigned patients, private notes including direct/query/export/download/print
Bank reconciliation permissions and native Payment Entry rounding; invoice/receipt/outstanding/drill-down canonical equality
Marley Fee Validity reference migration and Patient Appointment booking/move/cancel without semantic changes
Frappe session/file/report/migration changes and Builder framework UI asset compatibility
Desktop/mobile Agenda geometry and stale-response/search-select/debranding regressions
Synthetic-only fiscal/background jobs, idempotency, no real outbound transmission

g2d_reuse.harness_adaptations: Outside product, reviewed destination/replay/Italian labels/combobox/mobile and synthetic fixture mapping only; retain original failures and retests.
limits: One clean image build; no bit-identical second build
Some frontend transitive dependencies not fully locked
Do not compare final augmented dataset to initial seed fingerprint
g2d_reuse.evidence_reference: G2D REPORT.md and SUMMARY.json reviewed locally; detailed HITCH review pending; no raw logs or credentials included.

pass_criteria: All required gates and exact pins satisfied
Target build/app parity/runtime/migrate PASS with independently retained exit codes
39 suites executed PASS and target discriminants PASS; no unexecuted suite PASS
No unapproved role/visibility/business/accounting delta or leakage
Checkpoint integrity and actual CURRENT restore PASS including normalized schema/custom fields/custom permissions/file/business fingerprints
Protected original resources unchanged and no real provider traffic
Finish verification and safe stop by hard deadline
fail_closed: New permission expansion or compatibility issue needing product changes: stop for Owner; do not patch to pass.
Capacity or isolation not guaranteed: no resource creation.
No approved versioned manifesto: no build/start/migrate/restore.
Missing suite or unproven restore: PARTIAL, never PASS.
remaining_owner_actions: Review documentary PR and separately decide merge/activation; neither is authorized by documentation publication.
Provide authoritative CAP037 access or copy, without rerunning historic tests.
Provide sufficient isolated resource capacity or approve a defensible revised resource envelope; no cleanup or shared-environment changes assumed.
Establish exclusive mutation ownership before any future Docker operation; multiple Codex processes are visible.
Authorize future execution only with valid time boundary and all technical gates complete; publication does not extend previous expiry.
excluded: GitHub writes except authorized manifest-only documentation branch/commit/draft PR and linking comment on issue 99; no merge or main changes
Product changes or canonical pins changes

capacity_estimate.basis: Planning allowance: full CURRENT image archive about 8.53 GiB, TARGET about 8.53 GiB (estimate based on CURRENT), transient build space about 8.53 GiB, checkpoints/restored files about 2.4 GiB, safety reserve about 4 GiB; rounded 32 GiB. Peak memory budget is conservative and unmeasured for TARGET, no swap. Not an upstream minimum or a demonstrated peak. Shared layers/compression may lower actual usage but are not counted as guaranteed savings.
capacity_estimate.rule: Do not build to measure on shared host without a separately approved sufficient resource envelope; do not prune or stop existing environments.
